fields.description:
Mirror inventory finding F6 (`reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md`), MEDIUM.

## Problem

The set of ticket statuses has two masters:

- `src/rebar/types.py:21` `TicketStatus` (7 values), mirrored by
  `schemas/common.schema.json#/$defs/ticket_status` — canonical
- `src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:33` `_KNOWN_TICKET_STATUSES` — the same 7, hand-copied

The copy does not merely describe; it ASSERTS completeness. `_processors.py:565` raises
`ValueError(f"unknown ticket status in snapshot: {status!r}")` on anything outside it. So a
status added to `TicketStatus` and written into a snapshot by a newer clone makes that snapshot
UNREADABLE to this reducer — it raises rather than degrading. Nothing gates the pair
(`grep _KNOWN_TICKET_STATUSES tests/` returns nothing).

## Approach — generate-from-canonical

`_KNOWN_TICKET_STATUSES = frozenset(get_args(TicketStatus))`. `rebar.types` imports only
`typing`, so the reducer can reach it without a cycle; the in-tree precedent is
`_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_fields.py:119`, which already derives its type vocabulary the
same way.

This does not collapse a distinct concept (epic AC2): the raise site's message says "unknown
ticket status", i.e. it is asking exactly "is this a TicketStatus?", not a narrower question.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: `_KNOWN_TICKET_STATUSES` is derived from `TicketStatus`, not re-listed. Verified by a
      test asserting equality with `frozenset(get_args(TicketStatus))` and by the literal tuple
      being gone from the module.
- [ ] AC2: a status added to `TicketStatus` is accepted by the reducer with no second edit.
      Verified by a test that extends the compared vocabulary and asserts the derived set follows.
- [ ] AC3: behavior is unchanged for all seven current statuses, including that an unknown value
      still raises. Verified by the existing reducer suite plus a test asserting the raise on a
      genuinely unknown status.

## Testing

- `python -m pytest tests/unit -k "processors or reducer or status" -q` — AC1-AC3 and the
  existing snapshot-replay paths, which are where a mistake here would surface.
- `make lint && make typecheck`.
